div.head: Citing the handbook

p.hi: The whole handbook may be cited as:

div.p: The Menota handbook: Guidelines for the electronic encoding of Medieval Nordic primary sources. Gen. ed. Odd Einar Haugen. Version 3.0. Bergen: Medieval Nordic Text Archive, 2019. <http://www.menota.org/handbook.xml>

p.hi: A chapter of the handbook may be cited as:

div.p: Friederike Richter and Beeke Stegmann. “Initials and other illuminations.” Ch. 7 of The Menota handbook: Guidelines for the electronic encoding of Medieval Nordic primary sources. Gen. ed. Odd Einar Haugen. Version 3.0. Bergen: Medieval Nordic Text Archive, 2019. <http://www.menota.org/handbook.xml>
